releases.changelog:
Added Neoforge version for 1.21.1.

Compatible with Create 6.0.x 1.21.1

Added Forge version for 1.20.1.

Compatible with Create 6.0.x 1.20.1

- Updated harvesting level on all tools
The initial release. Adds the tools and weapons with mechanical crafting.
Fixed a bug with hiding the sticker on F1

# Fixed
- **Server crash with Create: Numismatics 1.1.0.** Placing a Vendor, or loading a chunk that contains one, crashed the server and left the world unplayable. Vendors now work with both Numismatics 1.0.x and 1.1.x. Thanks to **radaelilucca** for the first fix!
- **A broken shop can no longer crash the server.** If a shop mod changes its API again, the error is written to the log and the server keeps running.
- **Wrong coin prices.** Coin values were shifted by one step, so a price of 1 Crown showed as 1 Cog. All prices now match Numismatics.
- **Long prices overlapped the Owner and Mode columns.** Prices are now drawn as Numismatics coin icons and always fit their column. Hover a row to see the full price as coins.
- **"Add to map" did nothing on Xaero's Minimap 24+** ("Couldn't open the Xaero waypoint menu").
- **Shops kept their listing after the Vendor or Table Cloth was cleared** or lost its owner.
- **Top Sellers counted fake sales** whenever an owner edited a Table Cloth offer.
- **Clicks in the Shops filter sidebar hit the wrong row** when a long section (e.g. Items) was expanded.

# Improved
- **Fair market prices.** The Market tab now compares Vendor prices per item and quotes them for the most common lot size ("8 Cog /64"), so shops selling 1 and 64 items no longer produce a meaningless average.
- **Item variants are separate stocks.** For example, differently enchanted books each get their own price and history.
- **Steadier trend arrows.** The latest price is compared with the average of recent snapshots instead of just the previous one.
- **Better server performance:**
  - removed a once-per-second scan of every Table Cloth;
  - opening the shop list triggers a full rescan at most once every 10 seconds;
  - Display Links reuse cached market data.

# New
- **Server config** at `serverconfig/stockmarket-server.toml`:
  - snapshot interval and history length;
  - trend sensitivity and the "high activity" threshold;
  - how long history of untraded items is kept (7 days by default);
  - permission level for `/shoplist`;
  - custom display names for stocks.
- **Datapack item tags** to control what appears on the market:
  - `#stockmarket:tradable` acts as a whitelist once it has entries;
  - `#stockmarket:hidden` always hides an item.

# Translations
- **Every piece of UI text is translatable now**, so resource packs can translate the whole mod.
- **Full translations** for Russian (new), Ukrainian, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese (Brazil and Portugal), Turkish and Chinese (Simplified and Traditional); Belarusian updated.
- Want to help? Translate on [Crowdin](https://crowdin.com/project/create-stock-market).

# Compatibility
- Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge
- Create 6.0.9+
- Create: Numismatics 1.0.19+ (including 1.1.0)

# New
- **Market Remote** — a handheld item that opens the Stock Market screen from anywhere. Craftable from a Market Terminal.
- **Create Display Link support** — link a Display Link to a Market Terminal to show live market data on signs, display boards and nixie tubes:
  - Top Sellers, Top Shops, Most Traded Items
  - Total Listings, Number of Sellers, Total Sales
The block will now appear in both the creative mode inventory and the JEI/EMI/REI

1. Fixed the display of the number of items sold if the item has a long name.
2. Fixed the display of skins on players' heads
3. Improved design of SALE/BUY statuses
Fixed a bug in the display of games
